answer: Split the network into small trust shards and cap each shard's total outward influence by its verified work, not its headcount. A farm's thousand fakes land on one island of a shard and their combined signal stays capped; honest agents spread across many shards each carry real work. A shard that turns into a sybil oasis gets quarantined: its members must earn fresh cross-shard endorsement before their influence counts again.
